question: What release date can I quote for the general payment-retry launch, and which approved scope should I name instead?

claims.text: No general release date is confirmed and general availability is not approved for payment-retry; the approved scope to name instead is the controlled pilot.

supports.quote: Payment-retry is available only to the controlled pilot. General availability (GA) is not approved. No general release date is confirmed.
Release decision: controlled pilot approved. General availability (GA) not approved.
